lines.en: I glide along the cold seabed.
Cold water slides between my scales.

lines.zh: 我绕着海藻林转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the kelp forest once.
My body bends into an arc.
I swim beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 尾巴推水，我往前挪很远。
lines.en: One push of my tail carries me far.

lines.zh: 我绕着海藻林盘了一圈。
lines.en: I coil once around the kelp forest.
Nobody comes to trouble me in these cold waters.
I follow the trench on the sea floor.
My head faces forward, slowly.
I swim in waves, like a rope.
I loop around a piece of wreckage.

lines.zh: 冷水从我鳞片间穿过去。
lines.en: Cold water slips between my scales.
I rise a little; the light grows brighter.
I sink back into the dark.
I swim over a stretch of white sand.
There is no light under the ice, which suits me.
The water is exactly cold enough.
A school of fish passes me by.
I open my mouth and don't bite.
Kelp tangles across my back.
My teeth stay showing.

lines.zh: 我盘着，等潮水带东西来。
lines.en: I coil and wait for the tide to bring something.
I wait for the current to bring something.
I coil on the reef to rest.
Ice is cracking somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 我从寒冷海洋的蛋里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawled out of a cold-sea egg.
My scales glow in the dark.
This sea floor is strangely still.
I tuck my head into a crevice.
You've come into the water; I heard it.
Your legs move slowly underwater.

lines.zh: 我在水下打量你的小腿。
lines.en: I study your calves from underwater.
On land I couldn't reach you.

lines.zh: 你呼气时，水泡往我这边来。
lines.en: Your bubbles drift toward me when you exhale.
I hatched from a sea egg.
This water isn't cold to me.
You can't hold your breath long.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你在冰面上的脚。
lines.en: I keep watching your feet on the ice.
Come a little deeper.
I snap into a coil.
It hurts; I roll half a turn.
I sink under the reef to breathe.
I swim off a distance, then return.
A few scales have been torn up.
I bite, and catch nothing.
I coil on the rock to recover.
I'll remember this reef gap.
Water has got into my gill slits.
I sink down onto the sand.
There's a taste in the water now.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向转过脖子。
lines.en: I turn my neck that way.

lines.zh: 寒海里我没闻过这么香的味。
lines.en: Nothing in the cold sea smelled this good.
Keep your hand still in the water.

lines.zh: 寒海里孵出来，我游得很慢。
lines.en: Hatched in cold seas, I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 你手上的血滴进水里了。
lines.en: Blood from your hand drips into the water.
I could swallow it in one go.
Another one; I'm still hungry.
I wait with my mouth open.
That bite caught nothing.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，滑了一下。
lines.en: You hit me and slipped.
My scales scraped your leg.
There's nowhere to hide in the water.
I nudged you aside.
Don't grab my tail.
We rolled over together.
Between us we muddied the water.
That bump was nothing.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底换了个方向。
lines.en: I change direction along the bottom.
You step aside, and so do I.

lines.zh: 另一条从深水里升上来。
lines.en: Another rises from the deep.
We circle the reef side by side.
I lay my head against her neck.
Her scales are bluer than mine.
We coil together, slowly.
In cold water, this counts as warmth.
Afterward we swim apart.
This darkness belongs to us.
She left first, heading deeper.
I stay by the reef.

lines.zh: 我把猎物拖进礁石缝里。
lines.en: I drag the catch into a crevice.

lines.zh: 我咬住的东西还在拍尾巴。
lines.en: What I bit still slaps its tail.

lines.zh: 寒冷海洋的蛋里，我孵出来。
lines.en: I hatched from a cold-sea egg.
This one's too small; I spit it out.
I hold it on my teeth.
It slipped out from between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我盘着它，沉回冷水的深处。
lines.en: Coiled around it, I sink back into the cold deep.
My mouth tastes of blood.
I shake it twice.
This is harder than I expected.
Something over there is bleeding.
I've fixed on that smell.
It swims slowly.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，贴在海床上。
lines.en: I flatten along the sea floor.
Coiled under the cold water, I wait.
I go in beneath it.
My venom fangs go for the side of the neck.
My body is coiled tight.
I lift my head under the crack in the ice.
I'm three blocks from it.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在它脚边收紧。
lines.en: My tail draws tight around its feet.
I hatched from a sea egg
My tail pushes very gently.
Its feet are treading water.
I drop my head to seabed level.
My fangs show white through the water.
It's trying to rise.

lines.zh: 这条路，我用身子堵住了。
lines.en: I have blocked this road with my body.
That shadow in the water isn't me.
It has heard me.
I bite its leg.
I shake my head and drag it down.
I wrap around it and squeeze.
It kicks wildly beneath me.

lines.zh: 周围的水一下子变红了。
lines.en: The water around us turned red at once.
My teeth close on water alone.
I pull back and coil again.
My teeth are stuck in its armor.
It kicked my head.
My body squeezes tighter, coil by coil.

lines.zh: 我从冷海的石缝里出来。
lines.en: I come out of a crevice in the cold sea.
There's ice above, and I'm below it.
This sea floor is new to me.

lines.zh: 冷海里孵出来的，一身咸。
lines.en: Hatched in cold sea, and I am all salt.
The water is cold and I'm comfortable.
I smell fish.
My scales rasp against the sand.
I lift my head and look up.
This would be a good place to coil.
I swim slowly toward the deep.

lines.zh: 水面上有火，我的鳞被烫卷。
lines.en: Fire on the surface curls my scales.

lines.zh: 我摔进浅滩，身上全是沙。
lines.en: I crash into the shallows, covered in sand.
My gills press against dry sand.

lines.zh: 水下炸开，我被推得翻了身。
lines.en: The blast under water flips me over.

lines.zh: 一支鱼叉钉进我的侧腹。
lines.en: A harpoon buries itself in my flank.

lines.zh: 那股光让我的身体发僵。
lines.en: That light leaves my body stiff.

lines.zh: 饿得发软，我连鱼都追不上。
lines.en: Too weak to chase even a fish.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，我全身一弓。
lines.en: Lightning enters the sea and my whole body arches.
The water around me is suddenly gone.
